Data.subject: Labour, Employment, Wages and Productivity
Data.title: Employment Services (Year-To-Date), Monthly
Data.footnote: Data are based on date of data entry and are year-to-date figures, i.e., refers to the period from the first day of the calendar year up to the current date.  Data prior to Oct 2016 were from Singapore Workforce Development Agency (WDA), which was reconstituted into Workforce Singapore (WSG) in Oct 2016.  Career Matching Services (CMS) are delivered through physical and digital touchpoints of WSG and NTUC-e2i.

row.footnote: Refers to the number of people who received basic career advisory and/or registered for personalised career matching services through all physical and digital touch points of WSG and NTUC-e2i.  Data are based on unique counts of jobseekers within the reference period.  Data exclude the number of people who registered for training assistance only.

Refers to the number of people who were placed into employment through all physical and digital touchpoints of WSG and NTUC-e2i.  This includes those who found their own jobs after receiving services from the CMS touchpoints.  Data are based on unique counts of jobseekers within the reference period.
